calls.title: Add Ghost redirects to new site.
calls.summary: The team discussed several key areas to enhance website performance and user experience, including unresolved speed issues affecting page loading and scrolling, and styling errors on core pages. They highlighted the need for urgent fixes in blog content styling and planned a meeting with Kari for corrective measures. The lack of schema markup on various web elements was noted as a critical SEO gap. Additionally, the team aimed to optimize the presentation of testimonials and improve customer story pages. Bright Scout was confirmed as the main development partner for 30 days, emphasizing the importance of ongoing bug tracking and analytics improvements. The meeting also acknowledged a significant increase in organic traffic, relating it to enhanced SEO efforts.
calls.keywords: redirects, website performance, styling issues, testimonials, SEO schema, Bright Scout
